text.tspan: R13 limits reverse current into the cell.
1. PCF8563T is the PCF8563 in the SO-8 package (T = SO-8, TS = TSSOP-8, BS = HVSON-10); /5 or /F4 suffixes are revision/packing only.
BM8563 (SO-8) is a pin-compatible lower-cost alternative. I2C address 0x51 (RTC), 0x50 (FRAM, optional).
2. The firmware checks the PCF8563 VL (voltage-low) flag at boot; if set, time is invalid until an admin or the gateway sets it.
3. BR2032 (Li/CF, -30...+85 C) instead of CR2032 for an outdoor box. RTC draws ~0.25 uA -> the cell lasts many years.
4. Keep Y1 within 5 mm of U6 with a ground guard ring and no signals routed under it.
